title: NASA people invite him to lunch during a US Congress visit
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of NASA people invite him to lunch during a US Congress visit, about Late 1990s at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: When I was visiting as a member of the Russian Parliament in the United States Congress, um I received a call. Someone introduced themselves saying, "We're from NASA. We heard about your statement and would like to meet."

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, who later became president of a republic within Russia, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in the late 1990s, while visiting the US Congress as a member of the Russian parliament, he got a phone call. He says the callers said they were from NASA, the US space agency, had heard about his public statement of being taken by aliens, and wanted to meet him over lunch. If true, it would mean the US space agency took a quiet interest in his account.
